observations: Seven upright figures stand shoulder to shoulder across the full width; each has an oval head densely filled with red, black, and white scribble-lines, and a narrow elongated body outlined in black and white over broad vertical color strokes.
The upper third carries a horizontal band of orange-yellow radiating from each head, overlaid with loose black scrawl lines and a purple-grey strip; red scratch marks cross several faces.
The lower two-thirds uses wide vertical sweeps of yellow, blue, green, and magenta as the ground behind the figures, with white highlight lines running down the bodies and gathering at the feet.
reading: A row of figures presses across the full width, their scribbled heads blazing orange-yellow against a purple-grey upper band. Red marks crossing each face read as agitation rather than decoration. Bodies are tall color columns, leaving the heads to carry most of the visual weight. The crowding and shared upward flare give the group a collective charge that feels closer to noise than calm.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbor nnxyz nnotb #11 is fully non-figurative — a warm amber field of crossing marks with no body forms — making #12's shift to grouped figures a sharp contrast between these two owned works.
